name: horizon-asset-guard
description: Licensing, anti-copy and traceability kit for games sold between Meta Horizon Worlds creators: per-world license binding with pure TypeScript RSA verify and ChaCha20 over number[] (no typed arrays, no BigInt), per-buyer watermarked encrypted data modules, and a Node seller CLI (keygen, build, issue, trace, revoke, doctor).

scripts.test: npm run lint:runtime && npm run build:test && npm run test:crypto && npm run test:chacha && npm run test:core && npm run test:assetguard && npm run test:cli && npm run test:e2e
